explication: tweetXer is a browser-console/userscript tool for removing X content using a downloaded account export. The main workflow is to load an export file, choose a deletion mode, and let the script issue deletion actions while updating progress. README-documented branches also cover direct messages, bookmarks, slow-mode deletion, and unfollowing. The repository is a single source file; unsampled implementation details are represented only where the README documents the capability or flow.
